‘Muktijuddher Chikitsha Itihash’ unveiled
2022-12-29T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/muktijuddher-chikitsha-itihash-unveiled-3207656

A book titled "Muktijuddher Chikitsha Itihash" -- the first-ever book  on the history of medical treatment during the Liberation War -- was  unveiled in the capital yesterday.

Shahaduzzaman and Khairul Islam wrote the book based on their  five-year research, said a press release.

Prothoma Prokashan has published the book.

"It is still unknown to many how physicians  were also engaged in another war on the ground just like the freedom  fighters. This book will be a pathfinder in writing the medical-treatment history during the Liberation War period," said Dr Zafrullah Chowdhury,  trustee of Gonoshasthaya Kendra and one of the organisers of Bangladesh  Field Hospital during the war, while addressing the event at  Shilpakala Academy.

Padma Rahman, nurse of Bangladesh Field Hospital, said, "We had also  fought during the Liberation War with arms. But those arms were not  destructive, rather they saved lives."

Libertation War-time physician Kazi Misbahun Nahar, editor and  publisher of Prothom Alo Matiur Rahman, and director general of the  health directorate Prof Abul Bashar Mohammad Khurshid Alam attended the  event among other.
